mapper.select: SELECT A_MAIN_NO, A_MAIN_TYPE FROM PC_ANIMAL_MAIN ORDER BY A_MAIN_NO
SELECT A_SUB_NO, A_MAIN_NO, A_SUB_TYPE FROM PC_ANIMAL_SUB ORDER BY A_MAIN_NO, A_SUB_NO
SELECT I_MAIN_NO, I_MAIN_TYPE FROM PC_ITEM_MAIN ORDER BY I_MAIN_NO
SELECT I_SUB_NO, I_MAIN_NO, I_SUB_TYPE FROM PC_ITEM_SUB ORDER BY I_MAIN_NO, I_SUB_NO

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.STORE_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.BRAND, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, P.STOCK_QTY, P.A_SUB_NO, P.I_SUB_NO, P.PRODUCT_STATUS, DATE_FORMAT(P.CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CDATE, PA.A_MAIN_NO, PA.A_SUB_TYPE, PI.I_MAIN_NO, PI.I_SUB_TYPE FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN PC_ANIMAL_SUB PA ON P.A_SUB_NO = PA.A_SUB_NO INNER JOIN PC_ITEM_SUB PI ON P.I_SUB_NO = PI.I_SUB_NO WHERE P.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo}
SELECT FILE_NO, PRODUCT_NO, FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, FILE_SIZE, FILE_EXT, IS_DETAIL, IS_MAIN FROM PRODUCT_FILE WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} ORDER BY IS_MAIN DESC, FILE_NO ASC
